content.short: OpenMask is a non-custodial TON wallet for holding assets, connecting to dapps, and managing TON activity.
content.description: OpenMask is a TON-focused software wallet. Users can hold TON assets, connect to decentralized applications, review transactions, and manage network activity through a wallet experience designed for The Open Network. A safe crypto web extension wallet for The Open Network. TON blockchain has different interfaces from the rest of the blockchains, for this reason, it makes it impossible to adapt existing wallets to use it. Users see this through features # and openmask. OpenMask is listed for account access and custody workflows rather than for running a protocol market.
